(A fresh replay, after reconstructing the pinned identities, has machine-verifiable diagnostic categories exactly equal to the pinned semantic result.) AND (Any unexplained mismatch in a result-determining snapshot member prevents semantic reproduction and yields stale or another fail-closed terminal status.) AND (Each produced replay result has a complete Current Snapshot association covering every result-determining input, and partial or missing bindings cannot produce success.) AND (S41 测试确认任一必需执行缺失均使聚合失败。) AND (S41 测试确认该对抗性目标结果为非成功。) AND (S41 测试经真实调用面完成完整序列后确认 Route identity、verdict 和 diagnostics 分别等于其前序 identity 和基线。) AND (The S10 selector accepts a successful Replay Result only when a distinct independent Probe-verification binding is present.) AND (The S10 selector reproduces the recorded result from a fresh checkout using the complete bound Current Snapshot, while unexplained drift is stale or fail closed.) AND (The S16 selector proves every listed invalid identity or execution-fact condition prevents success.) AND (The S41 selector proves unexplained result-determining input drift cannot leave a replay result accepted as current.) AND (The S41 selector verifies both subject executions in all six Matrix Cases and rejects any missing execution.) AND (The evidence selector verifies an auditable historical validator reference and fails if the reference is absent or unverifiable.) AND (聚合 verdict 为 invalid 且 acceptance gate 被阻断；若仍 valid 或通过 acceptance 则失败。) AND (验证器确认六个 Matrix Case 均有执行记录、输入身份两两不同且绑定两个 subjects；否则返回失败。)
